newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 28.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on November 28:
WASHINGTON - AT&T Corp. has a surprise Thanksgiving gift for its residential long-distance customers -- a 5.6 percent rate increase.
WASHINGTON - After years of slow sales, apparel, jewelry and accessories are back at the top of gift lists.
WASHINGTON - The U.S. economy grew more slowly this summer than many government economists had previously believed, and well below the robust rate of improvement earlier in the year.
NEWARK - A Maryland surgeon, Charles Edwards, joined forces with another suitor to save Kiwi International Airlines with a $5 million loan.
